small_guidance: The conv_transpose3d kernel is compute-bound at 80% throughput but only achieves fast_p=0.03 because each thread redundantly computes index math for all IC*KD*KH*KW=432 iterations per output element. Reorder loops so the kd/kh/kw validity checks are hoisted outside the IC loop (currently kd/kh/kw are inside IC, but the kd/kh/kw index validity is independent of ic — move IC to be the innermost loop). Also accumulate via a 2D tile (BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_SPATIAL) with tl.dot over IC, treating the kernel as a GEMM where K=IC per (kd,kh,kw) tap. Fold BatchNorm scale/shift into the conv epilogue using precomputed bn_scale=gamma/sqrt(var+eps), bn_shift=beta-bn_scale*mean to eliminate the separate cudnn BN kernel.
large_guidance: Redesign as a gather-based im2col GEMM: one program per (N, OC_tile, output-spatial-tile) where the inner loop is over (ic, kd, kh, kw) flattened as the GEMM-K axis and uses tl.dot for the (BLOCK_M=spatial)x(BLOCK_K=IC)x(BLOCK_N=OC) matmul. For ConvTranspose3d, the gather formulation reads x[n,ic,(od+PD-kd)/SD,...] with validity masks (the current scatter-style direct convolution already does this but without tl.dot, leaving tensor-core-equivalent FMA throughput on the table). Fully fuse: (1) ConvTranspose3d, (2) BN folded as affine using running_mean/running_var/gamma/beta from the module, (3) per-(N,C) spatial mean subtraction. The mean subtraction needs a two-pass design: first kernel writes BN-folded conv output and accumulates per-(N,C) sum via atomic_add or a separate reduction kernel; second kernel subtracts mean. Use channels-last-like layout for OC tiles. Target BLOCK_M=32,BLOCK_N=32,BLOCK_K=16,num_warps=4,num_stages=2 first, then sweep up.
